sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 182)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network radio, three delightful musical broadcasts of *The Bing Crosby Show* (his 200th milestone show for GE, Allen Funt and *Candid Camera* pranks for Ford, and duets with Rosemary Clooney), Carlton E. Morse's *One Man's Family* (Book 54, Chapter 21) for Fleischmann's Yeast, Irna Phillips's *The Guiding Light* for Duz Soap, and *Fibber McGee and Molly* for Prudential Insurance (1945–1960):
